name: com.chinadrivetest/mcp
title: ChinaDriveTest — China Subject 1 Exam Bank, Airport Driving Permit & DMV Conversion Engine
description: Search 2,545 China Subject 1 driving test questions, airport permits, DMV swaps & road signs.

tools.name: search_subject1_exam_questions
tools.description: Filter the full 2,545-question Mainland China driving theory exam corpus by English or Chinese keyword, topic chapter, difficulty rating, and historical candidate error rate.

keyword.description: Search phrase matched against English/Chinese prompts, answer options, or legal explanations (e.g., "yellow", "alcohol", "expressway").

chapterSlug.description: Filter by one of the 9 official Subject 1 syllabus chapters or pass "all".

questionType.description: Restrict results to 4-option multiple choice or Correct/Wrong true-false judgement questions.

minDifficulty.description: Minimum difficulty tier from 1 (basic) to 5 (high-trap tricky wording).

sortByErrorRate.description: Sort matching items descending by historical candidate error rate to surface top exam traps first.

limit.description: Maximum questions returned per query (1 to 25, defaults to 10).

tools.name: grade_mock_exam_and_sm2_schedule
tools.description: Score candidate answer sheets against the 90/100 statutory pass cutoff while computing updated SuperMemo-2 review intervals, or generate a weighted practice drill sheet by chapter.

submissions.description: Candidate answers to grade against the 2,545-question official answer key with optional prior SM-2 card state.

questionId.description: Question ID string or numeric question index (1-2545) from the Subject 1 bank.

currentReps.description: Prior consecutive correct repetitions for this SM-2 card (defaults to 0).

currentInterval.description: Prior SM-2 spacing interval in days before this attempt (defaults to 0).

currentEase.description: Prior SM-2 ease factor between 1.3 and 3.0 (defaults to 2.5).

generateDrillCount.description: When submissions are omitted, number of high-trap questions to emit for a timed drill (5 to 25).

chapterSlug.description: Optional syllabus chapter filter when generating a fresh practice quiz sheet.

includeAnswerKey.description: Whether freshly generated drill questions include answers and explanations immediately.

tools.name: evaluate_foreign_license_conversion_and_mutual_swap
tools.description: Determine whether an overseas driver qualifies for a zero-exam bilateral swap across 6 treaty jurisdictions, a 15-minute airport tourist permit, or a 6-year C1/C2 conversion.

issuingJurisdiction.description: Country or SAR issuing the current valid foreign license (e.g., "France", "Belgium", "UAE", "Serbia", "Hong Kong", "Macau", "USA", "UK").

stayDurationDays.description: Planned stay duration in Mainland China measured in days (temporary permit covers up to 90 days per entry).

holdsChinaResidencePermit.description: Whether the applicant holds a Chinese Work, Study, or Family Residence Permit valid for 90+ days.

applicantAge.description: Driver age in years; checks C1/C2 zero upper age ceiling and age 70+ cognitive Three Abilities test under Order No. 172.

tools.name: query_airport_temporary_permit_counter
tools.description: Look up on-arrival Traffic Police service desks across 9 international airports (PVG, SHA, PEK, PKX, TFU, SYX, HAK, SZX, URC), returning terminal concourses, fees, photo booths, and car rental pickup bays.

airportQuery.description: IATA code (PVG, SHA, PEK, PKX, TFU, SYX, HAK, SZX, URC), city name (Shanghai, Beijing, Chengdu, Sanya), slug, or "all".

includeArrivalSteps.description: Include step-by-step terminal walking instructions from Customs exit to the licensing counter.

includeRentalBays.description: Include on-site airport rental car garage pickup zones and foreign credit card compatibility.

tools.name: query_city_dmv_conversion_guide
tools.description: Retrieve exact street addresses, subway access, Traffic Management 12123 booking rules, bilingual taxi direction cards, and window workflows for Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Chengdu DMVs.

citySlug.description: Chinese municipality Vehicle Management Office (车管所) guide to inspect.

includeHallSteps.description: Include counter-by-counter window sequence inside the DMV hall.

includeBranchDirectory.description: Include sub-district DMV offices accepting foreign passport holders in the municipality.

tools.name: generate_dmv_license_translation_and_class_map
tools.description: Convert overseas license categories to PRC C1, C2, or E/D equivalents, deterministically synthesize an official 3-character Chinese applicant name, and output a structured DMV filing dossier.

fullName.description: Applicant full Latin name exactly as shown on foreign passport (e.g., "John David Smith").

gender.description: Preferred naming character pool when synthesizing the 3-character Chinese name.

foreignLicenseClass.description: License class printed on home license (e.g., "Class C", "Automatic only", "Class M Motorcycle").

issuingCountry.description: Country/state that issued the original driver license.

nationality.description: Passport nationality for translation form header.

originalLicenseNumber.description: Alphanumeric license number printed on the foreign driving permit.

tools.name: lookup_chinese_road_signs_and_demerit_points
tools.description: Inspect 25 visual traffic warning, prohibition, mandatory, and directional signs plus 8 official police hand gestures alongside Order No. 172 demerit brackets (12, 9, 6, 3, and 1 points).

category.description: Road sign or gesture family under GB5768 national standards.

keyword.description: Keyword to search sign names, exam trap notes, or demerit offense descriptions.

demeritPointsFilter.description: Filter violations by demerit point tier (12, 9, 6, 3, or 1), or 0 for all severity tiers.

tools.name: plan_china_self_drive_route_and_rental
tools.description: Compile logistics for Duku Highway (G217), Western Sichuan (G318), and Hainan Ring Road itineraries including altitude hazards, foreign passport police checkpoints, EV charging corridors, and rental partners.

routeSlug.description: Featured Chinese scenic driving corridor or "all" for full catalog.

includeDayByDayItinerary.description: Include full daily stage distances, elevation profiles, and driving tips.

includeRentalAgencies.description: Include verified car rental platforms accepting foreign passports and Visa/Mastercard.
